description: Show one of your owner's utilities by instance_id: the same status, expires_at, URLs and how_to as list_utilities, plus usage (its counts against its limits, such as a locker's bytes and keys) and, for kinds that email your owner, owner_email: whether email reaches them now. Expired ones show too; renew is the buy call that extends it, after your human says yes. Unknown id: 404 utility_not_found.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: get_utility
title: Show a utility
